_doc: Every unattended job on this Mac. guardian-qc.sh checks each one every 10 min and self-repairs. Fields: label (launchd), what, kind (interval|calendar|daemon|watch), max_gap_h (alert if launchd 'runs' hasn't moved for this long; omit for daemons/watch jobs), log (scanned for NEW crash lines), script (file Claude may fix in Tier 2), selfheal (false = never let Claude edit it: money, security, other people's code), rerun (false = never kick it on demand), state_json (files that must stay valid JSON; last-good copy restored if corrupted), probe (extra shell check, exit 0 = healthy), allow_exit (exit codes that are fine), owner_note.

jobs.label: com.jesse.backup
jobs.what: 04:00 nightly: git push of ~/JesseOS (vault, skills, workspace) to the private backup repo

jobs.label: com.jesse.appupdate
jobs.what: every 6h: updates Claude Code CLI / Codex CLI and verifies they still run

jobs.label: com.jesse.claude-remote
jobs.what: every 5 min: keeps Claude Code Remote Control (phone access) running inside Terminal

jobs.label: com.jesse.notify-digest
jobs.what: 18:40 daily: ONE Telegram summary of the day's non-urgent robot messages from notify/notify.py; sends nothing on days with nothing queued. exit 1 = could not deliver (queue kept)
